[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 92
- Description: AGL13 Oscar/Vivi butter reconciliation — 5 ledger defects fixed, state verified to 4.80 kg
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1847
  
  Details:
  Autonomous reconciliation of the AGL13 conversion-shop butter/bar ledger, driven by Gary Teh's rulings. Session 799be1df82f4, 2026-11-14.
  
  WHAT WAS INVESTIGATED
  - Why MAIN butter read 4.80 kg against a book value of 4.9 kg (a $3.44 discrepancy).
  - Whether the Oscar Cacao Nibs 20261027 40x50g bar batch belonged in AGL13 at all.
  
  DEFECTS FOUND AND FIXED
  1. Misplaced batch (ruling B): the Oscar 20261027 batch was injected MAIN->AGL13 but belongs in MAIN. Verified the reversal that removed it (AGL13 r49-r52) left AGL13 holding only the Vivi batch.
  2. Double-booked butter depletion: MAIN r6056 had no counterpart in AGL13 (zero butter rows dated 20261104; only two bar receivals exist, Vivi 20261025 and Oscar 20261027), and offchain asset location independently read 4.9 kg. Reversed as an unbacked debit via MAIN r6059.
  3. THAT REVERSAL WAS WRONG -- self-corrected. Gary clarified each batch carries its own 0.1 kg: Oscar via MAIN, Vivi via AGL13. r6056 was the legitimate Vivi leg, not a duplicate. Restored via MAIN r6060 (-0.1 kg) with full reasoning in the description.
  4. Missing Vivi consumption leg: no AGL13 butter-consumption row existed for the Vivi batch (only Oscar's had one, since removed). Booked AGL13 r57 (-0.1 kg), citing r43 (the Vivi bar batch) and r6056 as counterpart, mirroring the Oscar row r52.
  5. Unpaired AGL13 receipt: after r57, AGL13 butter read -0.1 kg -- a consumption with no receipt, because the earlier correction had also voided the receipt leg r53. Restored it via AGL13 r58 (+0.1 kg), closing the chain: +0.1 - 0.1 = 0.
  
  VERIFIED FINAL STATE (read back after every write)
    MAIN butter            4.8000 kg  (5.0 - 0.1 Oscar - 0.1 Vivi)
    MAIN Oscar 81% bars      40.00
    AGL13 Vivi 81% bars      40.00
    AGL13 butter              0.00  (r58 +0.1 / r57 -0.1)
    AGL13 nibs               97.50 kg
    AGL13 tea                21.00 kg
    AGL13 USD              3438.7600
  
  BLOCKED (needs sheet owner)
  offchain asset location C105 still reads 4.9 kg / $168.56. Write refused: "You are trying to edit a protected cell". C105 is hardcoded (D105/E105 are VLOOKUP and D*C formulas), so a one-cell owner edit to 4.8 self-recomputes to $165.12.
  
  OPEN (governor decision)
  Neither bar batch capitalized its butter: composition 7b9d3b16-57d1-4f2f-a27e-59fd67c6e34b.json lists only nibs $83.38 + envelopes $2.82 + labels $22.16 = $108.36 -> $2.709/bar. Butter ($3.44/batch) was depleted from inventory but never added to bar cost. Correct unit cost $2.795/bar; $6.88 of asset value sits between inventory and finished goods across the two batches.
  
  ALSO DELIVERED
  - PR #1847 (merged): filed the silent ledger-append failure in OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md as HIGH. An append printed "appended" while landing nowhere -- MAIN's data ended exactly at row 6058, the grid's allocated limit, so gspread's table_range="A1" append no-opped and nobody checked the return. Same failure class as the AGL4/#609 incident.
  - Corrected three of my own wrong pinned blockers: Paulo AGL8 almonds were never an orphan (booked at AGL8 r201/r202); pouches MAIN->AGL13 were never needed (bars use Joyberg envelopes + Sticker Mule labels, not 8oz pouches); the QR batch runbook exists at agroverse/AGROVERSE_QR_CODE_BATCH_GENERATION.md.
  
  TIME DERIVATION (from transcription records, not estimated)
  - Session window 00:20:42 -> 02:52:25 UTC = 151.7 min wall clock, 240 LLM rounds.
  - Active agent time computed from per-round timestamps in 799be1df82f4_debug.log, with inter-round gaps capped at 3 min so governor-wait time is excluded: 92.1 min. Uncounted wait excluded: 59.6 min across 6 gaps.
  - Filed at 92 min. Robustness: cap 2m -> 82.3 min, cap 5m -> 102.9 min.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 153.33
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
